summary: This clinical trial is testing the study drugs mirikizumab and tirzepatide in adults who have Crohn's disease, which is a chronic condition causing inflammation of the digestive tract, along with obesity or being overweight. The study aims to enroll 290 participants who are experiencing moderately to severely active symptoms. Eli Lilly and Company is the sponsor for this Phase 3 trial, which is currently Recruiting. Participants will receive either a combination of mirikizumab and tirzepatide or mirikizumab with an inactive placebo.
